'''Tosha''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]]. He was married to [[Kiela (Devaronian)|Kiela]], but she had passed many years before. They had two daughters. Tosha conspired with fellow Devaronian [[Skerrit]] to transport a cargo of [[bandara]] to [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]].<ref name="A Necessary Evil" />
